verdict.rationale: Pulley documents downloading the cap table as an Excel file, either as of a specific date or for all time, which covers the core cap-table export in an open format. Nothing in the evidence shows an export of the full transaction or ledger history, or a CSV option. Missing for 10: documented export of full transaction/ledger history, CSV format support, confirmation that the export includes all security types/tabs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
